inputs.text: [serious] A herbivore. He grazed on plants in herds, never alone. [confident] Gorgosaurus and Daspletosaurus prowled around, [nervous] so the herd stayed tightly grouped.
[curious] How did they warn each other of danger?
[confident] With loud calls that carried far. [warmly] The whole herd would run to safety together, right at the first signal.
